title: Extract a shared Confluence client package; add Confluence-link fetching to document_area/start_documentation
description: Companion to ai-intake-mcp's confluence-references-in-planning.md: builds the shared @davindermahal/confluence-client package that plan deferred, migrates this server's own write-path Confluence tools onto it, and adds the same explicit-link fetch/citation capability to document_area and start_documentation.
